description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature within the 'Articles' namespace of a C# project, implementing logic for deleting articles based on a provided slug. It includes a command, validator, and handler for performing the delete operation, interacting with Entity Framework Core for database access.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug property of the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of an article identified by its slug asynchronously by interacting with the database context.

methods.name: CommandValidator()
methods.description: Constructor that sets up validation rules for the Command's Slug property.

methods.name: Handle(Command message, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the deletion process, throws an exception if the article is not found.
